audit.whatIsWrong: The page never named the two numbers that decide the lane: Shuriken Flip (E) at 16/14.5/13/11.5/10 is Akali's only reach, and Twilight Shroud (W) at 20/19/18/17/16 is the window where nothing can target her.
audit.why: Akali kit cooldowns and W text ('unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks').
audit.corrected: Difficulty comes from the flip, not the smoke: outside 825 with Grim Visage up, Akali has no way in.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer level row read 'Akali' while the content layer and the packet chart both read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei — the page rendered two opposite answers for all seven rows.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches content win[0..6] exactly; the full layer disagreed on all seven.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-3 Hwei (825 flip is her only reach and 550 Q her only poke), 4-5 and 6 skill (Perfect Execution 120s at rank 1), first item and 2+ items Hwei.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent and one was misattributed. Perfect Execution EXECUTES below an HP threshold, and Assassin's Mark makes her combo open with an empowered auto-attack, not a spell. The page also called the engage 'Shroud dashes' — the dash is Shuriken Flip's recast; the shroud only marks a target for it.
audit.why: Akali kit: R flags execute + dash; P flag autoReset with text 'empowers Akali's next Attack'; E text 'The first enemy or smoke cloud hit is marked. Re-cast to dash to the marked target.'
audit.corrected: Track the execute threshold rather than the health bar, read the auto wind-up as the cue, and hold Gaze of the Abyss for the flip recast.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint: COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.corrected: All three now carry their real numbers.
